panoramakit.screen.title: Panorama Kit
panoramakit.screen.subtitle: Pick the panorama behind the main menu
panoramakit.screen.vanilla.tooltip:
The default Minecraft panorama.
Hover it to preview, click it to switch back.
panoramakit.screen.entry.tooltip:
A panorama you captured.
Hover it to preview here, click it to use it behind the main menu.
panoramakit.screen.empty.hint: Press F6 in a world to capture one.
panoramakit.screen.hint.preview: Click to use it, Esc to cancel.
panoramakit.button.open.tooltip:
Choose the panorama behind the main menu.
Hover a panorama to preview it, click to keep it.
Press F6 in a world to capture a new one.
panoramakit.button.refresh.tooltip:
Rescan screenshots/panoramas.
Use this after adding or deleting panorama folders by hand.
panoramakit.button.open_folder.tooltip:
Open screenshots/panoramas in your file manager.
A panorama is a folder of six faces, panorama_0.png to panorama_5.png.
panoramakit.button.done.tooltip:
Keep the highlighted panorama and go back.
Esc does the same; hovering alone never saves anything.
panoramakit.message.applied: Panorama Kit: now showing "%s" behind the main menu.
panoramakit.message.load_failed: Panorama Kit: could not load "%s". See the log for details.
panoramakit.message.not_found: Panorama Kit: no panorama named "%s" was found in screenshots/panoramas.
panoramakit.message.capture_failed: Panorama Kit: could not create the panorama folder.
panoramakit.configuration.title: Panorama Kit Settings
panoramakit.config.choose.tooltip:
Open the picker to preview panoramas and choose one.
The same screen is on the title screen and on F7 while playing.
